pole_a.label: wellbeing_balance
sentences: We support a healthy work-life balance and a sustainable pace.
Your wellbeing matters — we offer generous time off and encourage real rest.
We care about mental health and actively guard against burnout.
Take the time you need to recharge; rested people do their best work.
Flexible schedules let you fit work around your life, not the other way around.
We invest in our people's health, families, and lives outside of work.
Sustainable, humane workloads are part of how we operate.
Excellent work should never come at the cost of your health or your life outside it.

pole_b.label: intensity_sacrifice
sentences: We work long hours at high intensity and expect total commitment.
This is not a job for the faint of heart; we go all in.
We move fast and grind to win, whatever it takes.
The pace is relentless and the work is demanding.
We expect people to be all-in on the mission, around the clock.
Comfort is not the goal; we push hard and sacrifice for results.
Hard work and hustle define how we operate here.
We hold an intense bar and accept nothing less than maximum effort.
